name: Bremelanotide (PT-141)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: Bremelanotide (PT-141) is a cyclic synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is Bremelanotide (PT-141) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Bremelanotide (PT-141) is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the PT certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (CAS 189691-06-3, formula C50H68N14O10, 1025.2 Da).

faq.question: How should Bremelanotide (PT-141) be stored?
faq.answer: Hold the sealed 10-vial kit at −20 °C, away from light and humidity. Once reconstituted, aliquot and keep at 2–8 °C; this PT preparation does not tolerate repeated freeze–thaw.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Bremelanotide (PT-141)?
faq.answer: Bremelanotide (PT-141) is stocked in 1 pack size (10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $68.94; 10–49 kits falls to $63.42 (−8%) and 50+ to $58.60 (−15%).
